parameters.command:
set +e
echo '===== [1] Archivos .env en Debian con DB_PASSWORD ====='
find /opt /etc /home -maxdepth 5 -name '.env*' -type f 2>/dev/null | while read f; do
    if grep -q 'DB_PASSWORD' "$f" 2>/dev/null; then
        h=$(grep '^DB_PASSWORD=' "$f" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2- | tr -d '"' | tr -d "'" | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}')
        srv=$(grep -E '^DB_SERVER=' "$f" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2-)
        echo "$h  SERVER=$srv  $f"
    fi
done
echo ''
echo 'HASH_CORRECTO=fa8baaebcdd1778250aa4fc5e4ebb490631c0d14d2e7c7d70460a66dab434cd2 (Twinc3pt.)'
echo ''
echo '===== [2] Scripts Python que usan get_conn_str o tienen conexion directa ====='
grep -rln -E '(get_conn_str|pyodbc\.connect|CONNECTION_STRING|sa;PWD)' /opt/scripts 2>/dev/null | head -30
echo ''
echo '===== [3] Cualquier credencial hardcoded en /opt/scripts ====='
grep -rln -E '(PWD|PASSWORD)\s*=' /opt/scripts --include='*.py' 2>/dev/null | grep -v '.env' | head -20
echo ''
echo '===== [4] systemctl services con DB_PASSWORD ====='
for svc in $(systemctl list-unit-files --type=service --no-legend 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}' | head -50); do
    if sudo systemctl cat "$svc" 2>/dev/null | grep -qE 'DB_PASSWORD|DB_SERVER'; then
        echo "--- $svc ---"
        sudo systemctl cat "$svc" 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'DB_|Environment' | sed 's/PASSWORD=.*/PASSWORD=<r>/'
    fi
done
echo ''
echo '===== [5] cron jobs con DB_ ====='
sudo crontab -l -u root 2>/dev/null | grep -iE 'DB_|pyodbc|sql' | head -10
for u in synapse n8n; do
    crontab -l -u $u 2>/dev/null | grep -iE 'DB_|pyodbc' | head -5
done
